certificate.note: The certificate quantifies over every illumination in each covered sub-interval and uses no simulator. Its product is the WIDTH, and the statement about the sub-intervals where nothing fails, which no amount of sampling can produce.

regulatory.note: Search finds a POINT. The certificate states a WIDTH and covers the sub-intervals where nothing fails, which sampling cannot do at any budget. Cost-to-first-failure is where search competes and it may win.
